title: TOC Semio Window Tables
summary: Fixed empty Semio TOC/register table rows: (1) materialize now stores literal row values via Nx+exp_not instead of symbolic tl/str register references; (2) compilePrintDocumentWithPanels always runs a second tectonic pass; (3) register list shells use Window not nested Table tcolorbox; makeworkpackages uses Window; semio-table resets row state and guards pageref on first pass. Tectonic log shows TOC row text at line 50 (26pt overfull paragraph); full PDF rebuild should be re-run locally via mit-bestand/bericht and print/script.ts test.
